lines.text: Some turtles breathe through their butts.
But the weirdest part is how long they stay down.
Meet the Fitzroy River turtle, from Australia.
Underwater, it pumps water in and out of its rear end.
Inside are two little sacs, lined with tiny branching bumps.
lines.caption: Inside are 2 little sacs, lined with tiny branching bumps.

lines.text: They pull oxygen straight out of the water.
So it can stay underwater for days without coming up for air.
Sounds fake? It's true. Follow for more.
